stories.title: Alcaraz Rolls Past Wu Yibing 6-3, 6-4, 6-1 — Best Flushing Meadows Win% in Open Era (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Alcaraz def. Wu Yibing 6-3, 6-4, 6-1. Grand Slam win streak: 17 matches.

Career record at Flushing Meadows: 27-3. That .900 win rate is the best in Open Era history — better than Sampras, Federer and Djokovic. #USOpen #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Alcaraz into US Open R4 vs. Tommy Paul.

Paul survived Bublik 6-4, 3-6, 6-7(4), 6-1, 6-3 in five sets. Alcaraz leads the H2H 6-2 and has won their past five meetings.

Still a dangerous matchup. #USOpen

article.headline: Alcaraz Rolls Into US Open R4 With Best Flushing Meadows Record in Open Era History

stories.title: Shelton Outlasts Shapovalov in 2 AM Thriller, 7-6(3) 6-7(5) 6-2 6-4 (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Ben Shelton def. Shapovalov 7-6(3), 6-7(5), 6-2, 6-4.

Match ended at 2:08 AM. He hit 14 aces. His fastest serve tonight: 147 mph down the T.

American power tennis is something else. #USOpen #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Shelton next faces Tsitsipas in the R4.

Power serve vs. craftiness. Louis Armstrong midnight theatrics vs. Greek baseline variety. It has all the makings of a classic. #USOpen

article.headline: Shelton Outlasts Shapovalov in 2 AM US Open Thriller: 14 Aces, 147 MPH, R4 Secured
